subject: Discovery recap & proposed PoC plan — FastRetail integration
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@fastretail.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@fastretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps (FastRetail)

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps to get a PoC moving: 

Pain points you shared:
- Search relevance for product catalog is inconsistent across categories, impacting conversion (especially mobile).
- Current costs for hosted embeddings have spiked during promo windows; need predictable unit economics.
- Strict latency targets for mobile search (p95 < 120ms for autocomplete) and for recommendations.

Current stack / constraints:
- Primary infra: AWS (us-east-1), services in Node.js and Python.
- Search layer: ElasticSearch + custom ranking heuristics.
- Security: must keep PII out of logs; SOC2 controls and customer-managed KMS required for production.

Success criteria for the PoC (what you want to validate):
1) 10–15% improvement in click-through rate on curated search queries (measured by A/B).
2) P95 latency for autocomplete < 120ms from our API endpoint.
3) Cost per query within 30% of current baseline after batching/caching.

Proposed PoC scope / timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): align on SDK language (Node/Python) and sample dataset; sign mutual action plan.
- Week 1: Redwood provides test API keys and a small SDK sample + compatibility matrix (attached).
- Week 2–3: Integration of SDK + sample calls; Redwood provides recommended batching/caching config.
- Week 4: Run evaluation queries and compare metrics; iterate.

Owners:
- Redwood: Ben (AE, technical lead) will help with SDK integration and config.
- FastRetail: Alicia will own product metrics and sample dataset; Tom will loop in infra/security.

Attachments: FastRetail_PoC_Scope_v1.pdf (draft scope), redwood-sdk-compatibility-matrix.csv

Next meeting: propose Thu Jul 2 10am PT for an integration touchpoint — does that work for you?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

--
Note: If you need us to sign an NDA before sharing sample data, we can route to legal.

Adding a few technical notes and links ahead of tomorrow's touchpoint: 

- SDK: Node.js SDK (v0.9.1) supports streaming completions, embeddings, and has a convenience client for batching. We'll attach a minimal sample showing how to do async batch calls to our embeddings endpoint.
- API compatibility: our REST endpoints are backwards-compatible across minor versions; we include a compatibility matrix (attached).
- Caching: Redwood supports prefix/KV caching; by default cache TTL is configurable and we never persist full request bodies unless explicitly enabled. We'll provide a short runbook for what is logged and how to configure KMS.

Attachments included for the meeting: redwood-sdk-node-sample.js, runbook-kms-logging.md

See you at 10am PT. I'll own the integration touchpoint on the Redwood side.

Cheers,
Ben
